title: Machine learning in predicting preoperative intra-aortic balloon pump use in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting.
summary: 236 retrospective cardiac-surgery patients, including 95 preoperative-IABP cases, are used to develop and evaluate the model.
ai_technology: Machine learning predicts preoperative IABP use among patients undergoing CABG.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital with Nanjing Medical University

evidence.tested: Single-center model development; prediction does not show that IABP use improves outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning predicts preoperative IABP use among patients undergoing CABG.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
